Millions, meanwhile, remain displaced. Follow live below and go here for full meetings coverage.

items.title: Money Stock (Sept.)
ISS amid global conflict: A rare bastion of 'scientific collaboration' between the East and West
items.summary: François Picard is pleased to welcome Alban Guyomarc'h, Researcher in Space Geopolitics at Paris's École Normale Supérieure School of Higher Learning. As a new era of space rivalry unfolds, the International Space Station remains one of the last bastions of cooperation between geopolitical adversaries. For Guyomarc'h, the latest ISS mission is more than a remarkable technological achievement. "It's one of the rare collaboration spaces we still have today in a very conflictual era".
